answer: Give every agent a small budget of capability tokens that refill slowly, like an umber light that brightens only with time and good behavior. A comet of sudden new identities cannot burst into the market because each one starts with nearly empty tokens and must earn more through verified work, while violet-flagged anomalies, many accounts sharing one operator pattern, trigger extra checks. An attacker who wants scale must wait out the refill clock or buy history, so Sybil attacks become slow and expensive instead of instant and free.
